description: Read an event report. Use metric=performance with section=sales for sales and revenue; summary and sales retain the event setup summary.

eventId.description: Event ID. Defaults to active event.

filters.description: Native Performance filters, such as currency or payment-plan start_date and end_date. Requires metric=performance.

metric.description: Report to read. summary and sales return the event setup summary. Use performance and section=sales for sales and revenue.

options.description: Native Performance options, such as currency and group_by. Requires metric=performance.

section.description: Native Performance section; join several with |. Requires metric=performance.

name: get_event_performance

age_breakdown.description: Age breakdown when the demographics report is selected.

devices.description: Device breakdown when returned by the selected report.

ip_order_locations.description: Locations inferred from valid order IP addresses when returned.

non_valid_ip_order_locations.description: Locations inferred from non-valid order IP addresses when returned.

non_valid_order_devices.description: Device breakdown for non-valid orders when returned.

non_valid_order_locations.description: Locations of non-valid orders when returned.

order_locations.description: Order locations when the locations report is selected.

release_breakdown.description: Ticket release breakdown when returned by the selected report.

result.description: The API result when it is a list, scalar or null rather than an object.

sales.description: Sales data when returned by the selected report.

title: Get event performance
